prior_results_preserved.Holm38_seed_only_FWER: 14/128, including P1 in 14 and P2 in 1

required_before_new_validation.requirement: Keep E_seed[sqrt(E_time squared error)] distinct from mean MSE, pooled RMSE, ensemble RMSE and a finite-calendar seed-conditional target.
required_before_new_validation.rationale: Model-specific finite-calendar square-root bias can differ even at equal population RMSE. Seed averaging does not remove it.

required_before_new_validation.requirement: Declare some rivals with population theta=0 and others with theta nonzero, using the actual equality null of P1/P2.
required_before_new_validation.rationale: The previous DGP named partial has bases 1+delta and 1+delta+.20: for delta>0 all equality nulls are false. Truth labels must be based on the null actually tested.

required_before_new_validation.requirement: Evaluate false rejections only on the known true-null subset, retaining all prespecified method/rival slots through Holm.
required_before_new_validation.rationale: Holm gives strong control under arbitrary dependence only when marginal true-null p-values are valid. It does not repair invalid tails, bias or an invalid studentizer. A global-EPA gate gives no protection under alternatives for which EPA is false.

required_before_new_validation.requirement: Report individual method rejection, per-rival intersection across required methods, and the complete scientific decision separately.
required_before_new_validation.rationale: An intersection of p-value rejections is not the full rule with direction, practical relevance, uncertainty and adequacy. An MCS global p or exclusion p cannot be copied as a third pairwise procedure.

required_before_new_validation.requirement: Choose and freeze B with explicit orderwise Holm tail resolution and numerical tie policy; report actual Monte Carlo p-value construction.
required_before_new_validation.rationale: The plus-one empirical minimum is 1/(B+1). B999 permits a first-rank rejection for 38 all-empirical slots, but not 57. In a mixed analytic/empirical family, earlier analytic rejections can change attainable later ranks, so this is not a universal zero-power statement.

required_before_new_validation.requirement: State seed exchangeability, cross-model pairing, temporal stationarity/mixing, moments, rates and the S/T regimes needed by the proposed method.
required_before_new_validation.rationale: The full square-root functional, S12, many rivals and shared calendars require justification beyond calling a method bootstrap-t or DM-HLN. Fixed bandwidth HAC and block length may understate temporal uncertainty. R-1 reference degrees of freedom are not automatically justified when temporal uncertainty dominates.

required_before_new_validation.requirement: Specify deterministic equal and unequal zero-variance behavior, near-zero MSE, bootstrap zero-scale roots and unsupported input handling.
required_before_new_validation.rationale: No selective removal of draws or rivals; unsupported values reserve family slots, cannot become zero-width certainty or a successful calibration result.

required_before_new_validation.requirement: Keep pointwise coverage, simultaneous coverage, equality testing and practical-margin assertions distinct.
required_before_new_validation.rationale: A pointwise CI95 does not become a simultaneous interval through a separate Holm correction to equality p-values. The guide's equality tests plus discussion of practical delta do not automatically require changing all nulls to a positive-margin null.

required_before_new_validation.requirement: Include global and true partial equality nulls, temporal and between-rival dependence, seed-only variability, heterogeneous temporal marginals or an explicit narrow claim, nonzero alternatives, coverage and degenerate guards.
required_before_new_validation.rationale: The earlier identical-marginal global null cannot reveal model-specific finite-calendar bias. Multiple best models also matter for MCS set coverage, beyond initial global rejection.

required_before_new_validation.requirement: Freeze seeds, code, DGP truths, methods, scenarios, sample counts, budget stops, all endpoint definitions, uncertainty intervals and acceptance thresholds publicly before new random validation.
required_before_new_validation.rationale: Non-detection of inflation with a wide interval is inconclusive. A bounded tolerance screen is not exact nominal calibration. Any selected method is development based on prior failures, never a retrospective preregistration.

required_before_new_validation.requirement: Document a distinct procedure's actual null, units, population and applicability; otherwise retain the third-procedure gap.
required_before_new_validation.rationale: Clark-West needs nesting, GW needs appropriate conditional predictive-ability design, Friedman needs justified independent blocks, and sign-flips/ranks need symmetry or distributional assumptions. Their availability in a guide does not establish validity for the same mean-individual-RMSE question.
